nodes.description: Heterozygous germline ACTB variants clustered in exons 5 and 6: missense p.Met313Arg and p.Glu364Lys, the in-frame deletion p.Ser338_Ile341del, and the last-exon frameshifts p.Ala331Val_fs*27 and p.Ser368Leu_fs*13. The tested transcripts escape nonsense-mediated decay, and the p.Ala331Val_fs*27 frameshift peptide was detected in patient fibroblasts, so mutant beta-actin is made. The changes fall in subdomain 1 and the C-terminus, which form the interfaces for myosin, alpha-actinin, filamin and profilin. The functional class is not settled: total beta-actin is reduced in patient fibroblasts, but the 2026 cohort study argues the phenotype matches ACTB loss of function (see discussions), so no functional impact category is recorded, and the cytoskeletal structural activity is marked abnormal rather than decreased or increased.
